query: SELECT id,CASE WHEN status=200 THEN 'ok' ELSE 'bad' END AS state,coalesce(amount,0) AS value FROM ${events} ORDER BY id
reason: COALESCE is not in the SQL V2 function grammar; IFNULL is supported.

query: SELECT id,sum(amount) OVER(PARTITION BY team ORDER BY id ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS total FROM ${events} ORDER BY id
reason: SQL V2 overClause has no explicit frame clause; default frame is supported.

query: SELECT id,sum(amount) OVER(ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS total FROM ${events} ORDER BY id
reason: SQL V2 overClause has no explicit frame clause; PPL streamstats covers bounded windows.

query: source=${events} | stats sum(amount) as total by lower(username) | sort `lower(username)`
